season_level.definition: every pair of teams meets exactly twice (once home, once away)
season_level.expected_schedule_rule: 2018 official: 23 clubs x 34 games; each club faces each conference opponent twice (1H/1A) plus 2 extra intra-conference games (East) / 1 extra (West); each non-conference opponent once. Observed: 132 cross-conference pairs met exactly once; 104 intra-conference pairs met twice; 17 met three times (extra games). Not double round robin.

season_level.definition: every pair of teams meets exactly twice (once home, once away)
season_level.expected_schedule_rule: observed from complete schedule: 24 clubs x 34 games; 132 intra-conference pairs met exactly twice (1H/1A); 144 cross-conference pairs met exactly once. Not double round robin.

season_level.definition: every pair of teams meets exactly twice (once home, once away)
season_level.expected_schedule_rule: COVID-shortened: 26 clubs, target 23 games each (299 scheduled); MLS is Back Tournament group stage (36 games) officially counted toward regular-season standings; 8 scheduled fixtures cancelled dnp (never rescheduled) -> 291 played. Observed from complete schedule: pair meeting counts 1-4 (17 pairs met 4x, 21 pairs 3x); heavily regionalized, unbalanced. Not double round robin.
season_level.field_locator: Season infobox (dates/teams/format) + MLS is Back Tournament page (group stage counted as regular season); pair counts computed from complete schedule

season_level.definition: every pair of teams meets exactly twice (once home, once away)
season_level.expected_schedule_rule: 2021 official: 27 clubs x 34 games (17H/17A); East: 6 regional opponents x3 + 7 remaining East opponents x2 + 2 cross-conference; West: 8 x3 + 4 x2 + 2 cross (11 teams) / 7 x3 + 5 x2 + 3 cross (2 teams). Observed: 28 pairs met once; 76 met twice; 93 met three times (93 = East 42 + West 44 + 7, matches official construction). Not double round robin.

MLS officially counted group-stage games toward 2020 regular-season standings (mlssoccer.com schedule announcement; Wikipedia MLS is Back Tournament). Knockout stage (15 games) excluded per request. 8 scheduled fixtures listed dnp (never rescheduled): COL-LAFC, CLB-LAFC, COL-LAG, DAL-MIN, SEA-COL, COL-RSL, COL-SKC, SKC-MIN. Wikipedia 2020 MLS season infobox says 292 matches (1 more than 291, unreconciled, possibly an infobox error or a counting difference). The request figure 302 could not be reconciled with any complete source (302-291=11; no 11-game subset identified: not the 8 dnp, not knockout games). Delivered 291 complete rows; validator should treat 302 as suspect.
